comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts a damper until carriage impacts stop safely; pr-1572 routes a curved board edge using a starting-pin entry and bearing-guided feed.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses hex-key alignment, collar rotation, counterholding, locking, and iterative test control. pr-1572 braces and pivots a board about a fixed pin, transfers it to a bearing, then feeds the curve in the safe direction while respecting hand clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two acceptable dynamic stops without bottoming or setting drift. pr-1572 requires a pin-started, non-climb feed routing at least 18 cm, cutter clearance, release, and specified final placement/arm conditions, with unsafe entry causing zero.
comparison.reason: Dynamic damper tuning does not test pin-braced workpiece transfer or curved feed control. Generic force control and guarded operation do not establish overlap. Candidate does not quantify excessive rebound, overload, or permitted drift.
